schema:
CREATE TABLE "effect_sql_migrations" (
  migration_id integer PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  created_at datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE flows (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0),
  graph_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(graph_json)),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
, coordinator_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'null'
  CHECK (json_valid(coordinator_json)))

CREATE TABLE t3_authorization_contexts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  authorization_identity TEXT NOT NULL,
  environment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE t3_connection (
  singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
  endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  context_id TEXT REFERENCES t3_authorization_contexts(id)
)

CREATE TABLE agents (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  prompt TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(prompt) <= 120000),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0),
  environment_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(environment_id)) > 0),
  provider_instance_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(provider_instance_id)) > 0),
  model_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(model_id)) > 0),
  model_options_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(model_options_json)),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
, coordinator_json TEXT
  CHECK (coordinator_json IS NULL OR json_valid(coordinator_json)))

CREATE TABLE projects (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  environment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  workspace_root TEXT NOT NULL,
  availability TEXT NOT NULL,
  observed_at TEXT NOT NULL, project_icon_json TEXT, favicon_path TEXT,
  UNIQUE(endpoint, environment_id, project_id)
)

CREATE TABLE project_selection (
  singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
  project_id TEXT REFERENCES projects(id)
)

CREATE TABLE runtime_proposals (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
  agent_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agents(id),
  context_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES t3_authorization_contexts(id),
  selection_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  before_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  after_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  approved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  validated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE runner_owner (
  singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),
  token TEXT NOT NULL,
  pid INTEGER NOT NULL,
  acquired_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE tasks (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE runs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  request_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  input TEXT NOT NULL,
  context_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES t3_authorization_contexts(id),
  workspace_root TEXT NOT NULL,
  gate_open INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(gate_open IN (0,1)),
  generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  closed_at TEXT,
  outcome TEXT
, stop_requested_at TEXT, title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE run_snapshots (
  run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES runs(id),
  snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE run_blocks (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
  block_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not-started',
  thread_id TEXT,
  execution_id TEXT,
  link TEXT,
  engine_status TEXT,
  report_status TEXT,
  pending_request_count INTEGER,
  observed_at TEXT,
  freshness TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', problem TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id,block_id),
  UNIQUE(run_id,thread_id)
)

CREATE TABLE operation_intents (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
  block_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  cause TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  payload_json TEXT,
  fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  context_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES t3_authorization_contexts(id),
  retry_scope TEXT,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN ('pending','reserved','uncertain','acknowledged','cancelled')),
  reserved_by TEXT,
  reserved_at TEXT,
  result_json TEXT,
  problem TEXT,
  reconciled_at TEXT, report_id TEXT REFERENCES runtime_reports(id), source_block_id TEXT, exit_id TEXT, occurrence_id TEXT REFERENCES human_occurrences(id),
  UNIQUE(run_id,cause),
  FOREIGN KEY(run_id,block_id) REFERENCES run_blocks(run_id,block_id)
)

CREATE TABLE run_events (
  sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
  block_id TEXT,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  observed_at TEXT NOT NULL, execution_id TEXT, cause_id TEXT, source_at TEXT, engine_status TEXT, binding_id TEXT REFERENCES run_thread_bindings(id),
  UNIQUE(run_id,source_key)
)

CREATE TABLE run_attention (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
  block_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  native_request_id TEXT,
  occurrence_id TEXT,
  appeared_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  settled_at TEXT,
  settlement_reason TEXT, message TEXT, binding_id TEXT REFERENCES run_thread_bindings(id),
  UNIQUE(run_id,source_key),
  FOREIGN KEY(run_id,block_id) REFERENCES run_blocks(run_id,block_id)
)

CREATE TABLE human_occurrences (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
  block_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  incoming_intent_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES operation_intents(id),
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN ('pending','answered','withdrawn','cancelled-on-Stop')),
  pending_context TEXT,
  appeared_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  settled_at TEXT,
  exit_id TEXT,
  answer_fingerprint TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY(run_id,block_id) REFERENCES run_blocks(run_id,block_id)
)

CREATE TABLE run_closures (
  run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES runs(id),
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('finished','stopped')),
  generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
  confirmed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  frontier_json TEXT NOT NULL
, coordination_json TEXT, root_frontier_json TEXT)

CREATE TABLE report_items (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  block_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
  observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id,block_id,item_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(run_id,block_id) REFERENCES run_blocks(run_id,block_id)
)

CREATE TABLE run_presentation (
  run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES runs(id),
  snoozed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(snoozed IN (0,1)),
  woke INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(woke IN (0,1)),
  CHECK(NOT (snoozed=1 AND woke=1))
)

CREATE TABLE run_snooze_attention (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_presentation(run_id),
  attention_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_attention(id),
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id,attention_id)
)

CREATE TABLE client_grants (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('desktop', 'browser')),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'denied', 'revoked')),
  secret_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  verification_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  requested_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  decided_at TEXT,
  last_seen_at TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE run_delegations (
  activation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES run_activations(id),
  request_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  input_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned' CHECK(state='planned')
, accepted_json TEXT)

CREATE TABLE "run_thread_bindings" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  block_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  environment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('direct-worker','coordinator','worker','descendant')),
  parent_binding_id TEXT REFERENCES run_thread_bindings(id), link TEXT,
  UNIQUE(run_id,environment_id,thread_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(run_id,block_id) REFERENCES run_blocks(run_id,block_id)
)

CREATE TABLE "runtime_reports" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  block_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  report_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('waiting','finished')),
  exit_id TEXT,
  recipients_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  pending_message TEXT,
  acknowledgement_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  accepted_at TEXT NOT NULL, final_contract INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, completion_eligible_at TEXT,
  thread_scope TEXT, activation_id TEXT REFERENCES run_activations(id), result_message TEXT,
  UNIQUE(run_id,block_id,execution_id,report_key),
  FOREIGN KEY(run_id,thread_scope,execution_id) REFERENCES run_executions(run_id,thread_id,execution_id)
)

CREATE TABLE "report_recoveries" (
  attention_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES run_attention(id),
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
  block_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  intent_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES operation_intents(id),
  requested_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  settled_at TEXT,
  thread_scope TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY(run_id,thread_scope,source_execution_id) REFERENCES run_executions(run_id,thread_id,execution_id)
)

CREATE TABLE "thread_settlements" (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  block_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  attempted_at TEXT,
  retired_at TEXT,
  outcome TEXT CHECK(outcome IN ('acknowledged','uncertain')),
  thread_scope TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id,block_id,execution_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(run_id,thread_scope,execution_id) REFERENCES run_executions(run_id,thread_id,execution_id)
)

CREATE TABLE "run_executions" (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  block_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  engine_status TEXT,
  report_status TEXT,
  observed_at TEXT, ordinal INTEGER, source_at TEXT, problem TEXT, native_request_count INTEGER, binding_id TEXT REFERENCES run_thread_bindings(id), activation_id TEXT REFERENCES run_activations(id),
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id,thread_id,execution_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(run_id,block_id) REFERENCES run_blocks(run_id,block_id)
)

CREATE TABLE coordinator_settlements (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  attempted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id,thread_id,execution_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(run_id,thread_id,execution_id) REFERENCES run_executions(run_id,thread_id,execution_id)
)

CREATE TABLE coordinator_native_items (
  activation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_activations(id),
  thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(activation_id,thread_id,item_id)
)

CREATE TABLE coordinator_waits (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  activation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_activations(id),
  parent_execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  report_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  acknowledgement_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_binding_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_thread_bindings(id),
  target_execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  attention_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_attention(id),
  UNIQUE(activation_id,parent_execution_id,report_key)
)

CREATE TABLE "run_activations" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  block_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  cause TEXT NOT NULL,
  phase TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'delegating' CHECK(phase IN ('delegating','waiting-worker','assessing','reported','finished')),
  coverage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unverified' CHECK(coverage IN ('unverified','local-bounded')),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  evidence_json TEXT,
  problem TEXT, task_context TEXT,
  UNIQUE(run_id,cause),
  FOREIGN KEY(run_id,block_id) REFERENCES run_blocks(run_id,block_id)
)

CREATE TABLE coordinator_revisits (
  activation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES run_activations(id),
  original_activation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_activations(id),
  receipt_json TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE "coordinator_task_results" (
  activation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_activations(id),
  task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(activation_id,task_id,source_execution_id)
)

CREATE TABLE coordinator_recoveries (
  attention_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES report_recoveries(attention_id),
  activation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES run_activations(id),
  parent_binding_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_thread_bindings(id),
  worker_binding_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_thread_bindings(id),
  worker_execution_id TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE coordinator_stop_requests (
  intent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES operation_intents(id),
  scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope IN ('owned-tree','queued-execution'))
)

CREATE TABLE coordinator_releases (
  activation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES run_activations(id),
  report_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES runtime_reports(id),
  generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
  context_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  frontier_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  released_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE coordinator_native_obligations (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  block_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id,thread_id,execution_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(run_id,block_id) REFERENCES run_blocks(run_id,block_id)
)

CREATE TABLE coordinator_remote_work (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  activation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_activations(id),
  parent_thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  task_id TEXT,
  environment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  thread_id TEXT,
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  available INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  pending_request_count INTEGER,
  observed_at TEXT,
  resolved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  CHECK((task_id IS NULL) = (thread_id IS NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE coordinator_peer_obligations (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
  environment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  root_thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('member','queued','execution','native','nested')),
  reference TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id,environment_id,root_thread_id,thread_id,kind,reference)
)

CREATE TABLE coordinator_local_executions (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
  thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  parent_thread_id TEXT,
  provider_instance_id TEXT,
  model TEXT,
  ordinal INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id,thread_id,execution_id)
)

CREATE TABLE run_coordinators (
  run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES runs(id),
  selection_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  payload_json TEXT,
  fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  retry_scope TEXT,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN ('pending','reserved','uncertain','acknowledged','cancelled')),
  reserved_by TEXT,
  reserved_at TEXT,
  thread_id TEXT UNIQUE,
  execution_id TEXT,
  link TEXT,
  engine_status TEXT,
  problem TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  acknowledged_at TEXT
, instruction_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(instruction_version IN (0,1)), freshness TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', observed_at TEXT, pending_request_count INTEGER, queued_count INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE run_coordinator_commands (
  activation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES run_activations(id),
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_coordinators(run_id),
  request_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  invocation_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  invocation_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  plan_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  send_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  send_json TEXT,
  send_fingerprint TEXT,
  retry_scope TEXT,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN ('pending','reserved','uncertain','issued','accepted')),
  parent_execution_id TEXT,
  accepted_json TEXT,
  thread_id TEXT UNIQUE,
  execution_id TEXT,
  problem TEXT,
  context_granted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(context_granted IN (0,1))
, context_call_id TEXT, context_reply_json TEXT, intent_id TEXT REFERENCES operation_intents(id), context_execution_id TEXT, cancelled_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE run_coordinator_obligations (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_coordinators(run_id),
  source_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id,source_key)
)

CREATE TABLE coordinator_question_replies (
  attention_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES run_attention(id),
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  message TEXT NOT NULL,
  intent_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES operation_intents(id),
  activation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_activations(id),
  binding_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_thread_bindings(id),
  UNIQUE(run_id,request_id)
)

CREATE TABLE coordinator_native_human_replies (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
  thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id,thread_id,item_id)
)

CREATE TABLE run_root_obligations (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_coordinators(run_id),
  thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('member','execution','native','remote','command','followup')),
  reference TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id,thread_id,kind,reference)
)

CREATE TABLE run_root_stop_intents (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_coordinators(run_id),
  cause TEXT NOT NULL,
  thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','reserved','uncertain','acknowledged')),
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id,cause)
)

CREATE TABLE run_root_cancelled_controls (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_coordinators(run_id),
  source_execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id,source_execution_id)
)

CREATE TABLE assessment_checkpoints (
 activation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES run_activations(id),
 report_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES runtime_reports(id),
 reporter_thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 reporter_execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE run_control_recoveries (
 run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_coordinators(run_id),
 source_execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 activation_id TEXT REFERENCES run_coordinator_commands(activation_id),
 request_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 retry_scope TEXT,
 state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN ('pending','reserved','uncertain','acknowledged')),
 acknowledgement_json TEXT,
 completed_execution_id TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(run_id,source_execution_id)
)

CREATE TABLE coordinator_bootstrap_recoveries (
 activation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES run_coordinator_commands(activation_id),
 source_execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 intent_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES operation_intents(id)
)

CREATE TABLE coordinator_native_commands (
 run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
 block_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
 evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(run_id,thread_id,item_id,fingerprint)
)

CREATE TABLE run_root_settlements (
  run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES runs(id),
  thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  attempted_at TEXT,
  retired_at TEXT,
  outcome TEXT CHECK(outcome IN ('acknowledged','uncertain'))
)

CREATE TABLE run_worker_activations (
  activation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES run_activations(id),
  binding_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES run_thread_bindings(id),
  initial_execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  parent_thread_id TEXT NOT NULL
)
postDataSchema: CREATE INDEX flows_listing ON flows (created_at DESC, id ASC)
CREATE INDEX agents_listing ON agents (updated_at DESC, id ASC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_open_run_per_task ON runs(task_id) WHERE closed_at IS NULL
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_run_snapshot_delete BEFORE DELETE ON run_snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Run snapshots are immutable'); END
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_reservation_per_run ON operation_intents(run_id) WHERE state='reserved'
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_run_closure_delete BEFORE DELETE ON run_closures BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Closure evidence is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wake_run_on_new_attention AFTER INSERT ON run_attention
WHEN NEW.settled_at IS NULL
BEGIN
  UPDATE run_presentation SET snoozed=0,woke=1
  WHERE run_id=NEW.run_id AND snoozed=1
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM run_closures WHERE run_id=NEW.run_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM run_snooze_attention WHERE run_id=NEW.run_id AND attention_id=NEW.id);
END

CREATE TRIGGER settle_run_presentation AFTER INSERT ON run_closures
BEGIN
  UPDATE run_presentation SET snoozed=0,woke=0 WHERE run_id=NEW.run_id;
END

CREATE TRIGGER wake_run_on_increased_native_attention AFTER UPDATE OF pending_request_count ON run_blocks
WHEN NEW.pending_request_count > OLD.pending_request_count
BEGIN
  UPDATE run_presentation SET snoozed=0,woke=1
  WHERE run_id=NEW.run_id AND snoozed=1
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM run_closures WHERE run_id=NEW.run_id)
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM run_attention WHERE run_id=NEW.run_id AND block_id=NEW.block_id
      AND kind='native-request' AND settled_at IS NULL);
END
CREATE INDEX client_grants_status ON client_grants(status, requested_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_final_result ON runtime_reports(run_id,block_id,execution_id) WHERE final_contract=1
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_activation_result ON runtime_reports(activation_id) WHERE activation_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TRIGGER scope_runtime_reports AFTER INSERT ON runtime_reports WHEN NEW.thread_scope IS NULL BEGIN UPDATE runtime_reports SET thread_scope=(SELECT thread_id FROM run_blocks WHERE run_id=NEW.run_id AND block_id=NEW.block_id) WHERE rowid=NEW.rowid; END

CREATE TRIGGER scope_report_recoveries AFTER INSERT ON report_recoveries WHEN NEW.thread_scope IS NULL BEGIN UPDATE report_recoveries SET thread_scope=(SELECT thread_id FROM run_blocks WHERE run_id=NEW.run_id AND block_id=NEW.block_id) WHERE rowid=NEW.rowid; END

CREATE TRIGGER scope_thread_settlements AFTER INSERT ON thread_settlements WHEN NEW.thread_scope IS NULL BEGIN UPDATE thread_settlements SET thread_scope=(SELECT thread_id FROM run_blocks WHERE run_id=NEW.run_id AND block_id=NEW.block_id) WHERE rowid=NEW.rowid; END

CREATE TRIGGER immutable_activation_report BEFORE UPDATE OF activation_id,result_message,execution_id,fingerprint,status,exit_id,acknowledgement_json ON runtime_reports
WHEN OLD.activation_id IS NOT NULL
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Activation results are immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER immutable_execution_identity BEFORE UPDATE OF run_id,block_id,thread_id,execution_id ON run_executions
WHEN NEW.run_id IS NOT OLD.run_id OR NEW.block_id IS NOT OLD.block_id OR NEW.thread_id IS NOT OLD.thread_id OR NEW.execution_id IS NOT OLD.execution_id
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Execution identity is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER bind_run_execution AFTER INSERT ON run_executions WHEN NEW.binding_id IS NULL BEGIN
  INSERT INTO run_thread_bindings(id,run_id,block_id,environment_id,thread_id,role)
  SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))),NEW.run_id,NEW.block_id,c.environment_id,NEW.thread_id,
    CASE json_extract(s.snapshot_json,'$.executionContract') WHEN 'coordinator-child-v1' THEN 'coordinator' ELSE 'direct-worker' END
  FROM runs r JOIN run_snapshots s ON s.run_id=r.id JOIN t3_authorization_contexts c ON c.id=r.context_id WHERE r.id=NEW.run_id
  ON CONFLICT(run_id,environment_id,thread_id) DO NOTHING;
  UPDATE run_executions SET binding_id=(SELECT id FROM run_thread_bindings WHERE run_id=NEW.run_id AND thread_id=NEW.thread_id),
    activation_id=(SELECT a.id FROM run_activations a JOIN operation_intents i ON i.run_id=a.run_id AND i.cause=a.cause
      WHERE a.run_id=NEW.run_id AND a.block_id=NEW.block_id AND i.kind IN ('launch','send') AND i.state='acknowledged'
        AND json_extract(i.result_json,'$.threadId')=NEW.thread_id AND json_extract(i.result_json,'$.runId')=NEW.execution_id)
  WHERE run_id=NEW.run_id AND thread_id=NEW.thread_id AND execution_id=NEW.execution_id;
END

WHEN OLD.binding_id IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.binding_id IS NOT OLD.binding_id OR
 (NEW.activation_id IS NOT OLD.activation_id AND (OLD.activation_id IS NOT NULL OR NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM coordinator_revisits v JOIN run_activations a ON a.id=v.activation_id
   WHERE v.activation_id=NEW.activation_id AND a.run_id=NEW.run_id AND a.block_id=NEW.block_id AND
   ((json_extract(v.receipt_json,'$.parentRunId')=NEW.execution_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM run_thread_bindings b WHERE b.id=NEW.binding_id AND b.role='coordinator')) OR (json_extract(v.receipt_json,'$.threadId')=NEW.thread_id AND json_extract(v.receipt_json,'$.runId')=NEW.execution_id)
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM coordinator_task_results t WHERE t.activation_id=v.activation_id AND
      ((t.thread_id=NEW.thread_id AND t.execution_id=NEW.execution_id) OR
       (t.source_execution_id=NEW.execution_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM run_thread_bindings b WHERE b.id=NEW.binding_id AND b.role='coordinator')))))
 ))))
AND NOT (OLD.binding_id=NEW.binding_id AND OLD.activation_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM run_worker_activations w JOIN coordinator_native_human_replies h ON h.run_id=NEW.run_id AND h.thread_id=NEW.thread_id AND h.execution_id=NEW.execution_id JOIN coordinator_waits q ON q.activation_id=w.activation_id JOIN run_attention a ON a.id=q.attention_id JOIN run_executions prior ON prior.binding_id=q.target_binding_id AND prior.execution_id=q.target_execution_id WHERE w.activation_id=NEW.activation_id AND w.binding_id=NEW.binding_id AND a.settled_at IS NULL AND prior.ordinal<NEW.ordinal))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Execution membership is immutable'); END
